name: blackswan-cross-cot
description: The CROSS-SECTIONAL COT probe — the structurally-different positioning thread (relative value, MARKET-NEUTRAL). Every single-asset positioning probe nulled because its tempting cells were BETA (long a rising commodity); this removes that beta by construction. Each bar it ranks a metals+energy+ags basket (GOLD/SILVER/COPPER/WTI/CORN/WHEAT) by managed-money positioning extremity (the trailing Williams COT index of net/OI) and goes LONG the k least-crowded / SHORT the k most-crowded (cross_contrarian), or the reverse (cross_momentum) — a dollar-neutral long/short, so the common commodity beta cancels and only a genuine RELATIVE-positioning edge can survive. Reuses cot.py's release-lagged join + trailing COT index; the cross-sectional ranking + the market-neutral portfolio backtest are the new surface. Commodities are aligned on a common daily axis (union of the basket's bar dates) with forward-filled closes; the position decided at day t earns day t+1's return; positions never read price; the COT score is release-lagged + past-only. There is no buy-and-hold benchmark (dollar-neutral), so the decider is the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe of the long/short portfolio. Deterministic and model-free (the seed is contract-only). DATA: cot/<SYM>.json + commodities/<SYM>-1d-*.json for the basket.

basket.description: The commodity basket ranked and traded. complex6 = GOLD, SILVER, COPPER, WTI, CORN, WHEAT (metals + energy + ags), each with free CFTC COT and yfinance price. NATGAS is excluded (its COT commodity_name is dominated by ICE swaps that do not match the NG=F futures price).

signal.description: cross_contrarian goes LONG the least-crowded commodities (lowest COT index) and SHORT the most-crowded (crowded specs unwind); cross_momentum rides the crowd (long most-crowded / short least-crowded). Dollar-neutral either way. An unknown value is refused.

cross_k.description: How many commodities to hold on each side (long k / short k). With a 6-commodity basket, k=2 leaves 2 flat; larger k widens the book toward the full complex.

cot_index_window.description: The trailing window (bars) for the per-commodity Williams COT index used as the cross-sectional ranking score. ~756 = 3yr, regime-adaptive.

min_history.description: Bars of trailing history required before a commodity's COT index (hence its rank) is defined.

release_lag_days.description: COT publication lag: a report dated Tuesday D is usable only from D + release_lag_days (the Monday after the Friday release).

transaction_fee.description: Per-side fee charged on the daily turnover of the long/short book (~0.1% round trip per unit of weight change).

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED. A real relative-positioning edge must hold in a MAJORITY of these five regime-diverse years, not one.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the backtest is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
